name: Daybreak

description.project: A habit and morning-routine application that helps people plan recurring activities, track daily progress, and build consistent routines.
description.technical: Fullstack web application built with Next.js and TypeScript. Uses PostgreSQL with Drizzle ORM for persistence, Zod for input validation, and Tailwind CSS with shadcn/ui for the interface.

features.name: Recurring habits
features.description: Users can create habits with recurrence schedules and track whether they complete them each day.
features.implementation: Modeled habits separately from daily completion records. Added recurrence configuration and date-based queries to retrieve the expected habits for a given day and calculate completion history.

features.name: Routine builder
features.description: Users can assemble a morning routine from ordered activities and track progress while completing it.
features.implementation: Built routine and routine-item management flows with configurable ordering, completion state, and server-side mutations. Kept routine definitions separate from individual daily run records.

features.name: Reminder preferences
features.description: Users can configure reminders for individual habits and routines.
features.implementation: Stored reminder preferences alongside their associated habits and routines, including the user's selected local time and timezone for future scheduled delivery.

highlights: Separated recurring habit definitions from daily completion records.
Built configurable routines with ordered activities and daily progress tracking.
Designed reminder preferences around user-local time and timezone settings.
